domain_label: Rationale and scope of the PCCP
definition: Why the PCCP was pursued and how its intended coverage was bounded.
include_when: Motivation; included or excluded modifications; perceived boundaries.
exclude_when: Preparation effort goes to D3; FDA exchanges go to D4.

definition: How usable the written guidance was for preparing the PCCP.
include_when: Clarity; worked examples; difficulty across the three PCCP components.
exclude_when: Review-specific expectations or requests go to D4.

definition: Resources, evidence, and organizational processes required to prepare the PCCP.
include_when: Length; resource intensity; evidence at submission; quality-management or internal-process changes.
exclude_when: Implementation outcomes after authorization go to D5.

definition: Experiences of regulatory interaction and review.
include_when: Pre-Submission or Q-Submission; review rounds; revisions; consistency; proportionality.
exclude_when: General written-guidance clarity goes to D2.

definition: What happened after authorization and how the PCCP affected organizational practice.
include_when: Implementation status; barriers; documentation; communication; product planning; organizational diffusion.
exclude_when: Overall value judgments and future use go to D6.

definition: Overall value, future intentions, and recommended changes.
include_when: Worth; conditions for reuse; desired framework changes; messages to regulators.
exclude_when: Specific preparation or review experiences remain in D1-D5.

definition: Participant accounts comparing regulatory approaches to managing device changes across jurisdictions, including consequences for coordinating product releases, versions, portfolios and quality-management processes.
include_when: Comparisons between FDA PCCPs and other change-management pathways; cross-market harmonization, release coordination or version-control effects explicitly linked to differing regulatory requirements.
exclude_when: FDA-only guidance, preparation or implementation accounts remain under D1–D6. Link an account to D7 when cross-jurisdiction differences are explicit; preserve relevant D1–D6 links and count each interview only once per domain.
